results.question: ลูกค้าที่มียอดชำระเงินรวมสูงกว่าค่าเฉลี่ย
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY customerNumber)) LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:

  c.customerName,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment
FROM customers AS c
JOIN payments AS p
  ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber
GROUP BY
  c.customerNumber,
  c.customerName
HAVING
  SUM(p.amount) > (
    SELECT
      AVG(total_amount)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
      FROM payments
      GROUP BY
        customerNumber
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  total_payment DESC
LIMIT 500

results.gold_sql: SELECT o.city AS office, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber) AS employees, ROUND(SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber), 2) AS sales_per_employee FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber LEFT JOIN orders ord ON c.customerNumber = ord.customerNumber LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON ord.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  of.city AS office_city,
  e.firstName,
  e.lastName,
  SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total_sales
FROM orderdetails AS od
JOIN orders AS o
  ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber
JOIN customers AS c
  ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber
JOIN employees AS e
  ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber
JOIN offices AS of
  ON e.officeCode = of.officeCode
GROUP BY
  of.city,
  e.employeeNumber
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC
LIMIT 500
